summary: Defined ecosystem signing, key rotation and revocation requirements for Production Distro promotion.
acceptance_evidence: Signed objects include manifests, payloads, registry snapshots, lockfiles, policy packs, adapter packs, image packs and revocation metadata.
Revoked active artifacts are degraded and remain visible in operator projection and support bundles.
Local-dev unsigned exception is explicit and non-promotable.

commands.summary: Replay passed with revoked staged artifact blocked and active revoked artifact degraded evidence.

blocked_shortcuts: Candidate hash-bound release signatures do not satisfy production trust root requirements.
Revocation metadata is not optional for production promotion.
Copying local-dev artifacts into a trusted path does not upgrade them.
promotion_impact: Production Distro now has documented signing and revocation requirements before public registry or verified publisher work.
